resolutions.researcher_notes: SCOPE / AGGREGATE NOTE FOR THE TRUNK PARENT — no existence, duplication or classification problem with this row; it is the genuine WEP3 system row (Khorgas→Fuzhou, 7,378 km) and the parent of P4931 (middle) and P4928 (east). Filed so the merge can see which figures are system-scoped and which are not. (1) SEGMENTCOST: the sheet's 125,000,000,000 RMB is CORRECT for this row and IS sourced at system scope — 中新网 2012-10-22, '西三线包括1条干线8条支线3座储气库和1座液化天然气应急调峰站，总投资1250亿元'. The carried v2 __VALIDITY__ on SegmentCost scope is therefore RESOLVED for this row, and the ref already in the cell is live (see the encoding caveat below). Three OTHER investment figures exist for WEP3 and none of them belongs in this cell: 1160 亿元 (Baosteel, a 2012 preliminary estimate for the JV's scope), 超过1200 亿元 (国家能源局 2012-10-22, a rounded contemporaneous figure), and 436.48 亿元 (the 2014 NDRC 核准 for the MIDDLE section only — a SECTION figure; RELAUNCH_NOTES item 3 also lists 44.7e9 / 436.48亿 as WEP3 system-vs-segment traps). (2) LENGTH: 7,378 km is the SYSTEM total (1 trunk + 8 branches; OGJ, 国家能源局, chinanews ×2). The TRUNK alone is 5,220 km (Baosteel spec table; OGJ 'the 5,220-km trunk'). Both are correct at their own scope — the sheet's 7,378 km matches its own '1 trunk + 8 branches' extent and should not be swapped for 5,220. Section lengths are 2,732 km / 2,090 km (middle, MEE / 澎湃) and 832.4 km (east). (3) PRESSURE is not uniform along the line: 12 MPa 中卫-枣阳, 10 MPa 枣阳-吉安 and 吉安-福州 (MEE 环审〔2014〕16号; Xinhua 2025). The staged 12/10 MPa records the range OGJ gives for the line as a whole; a single scalar would be wrong at one end or the other. (4) TOOLING DEFECT worth reporting: url_verifier returns 'FAIL 200 but name not found' for EVERY chinanews.com.cn article, including the one already in this row's SegmentCost [ref] cell (https://www.chinanews.com.cn/ny/2012/10-22/4264426.shtml) and the two new refs used above. The host serves GB-mixed bytes that Python's strict gb18030 AND utf-8 decoders both reject, so the verifier extracts no text at all; decoded with errors='replace' the pages read cleanly and contain 西气东输三线 verbatim. These are ENCODING false negatives on live HTTP 200 pages — encoded here as ok:true / name_found:true with the evidence in each note, per the hand-confirmed-false-negative convention. RELAUNCH_NOTES item 6 records that chinanews stopped false-flagging as BLOCKED after the 09-04 verifier fix; this is a separate, still-open decoding failure.

resolutions.researcher_notes: OWNERSHIP STRUCTURE — a decision is owed at merge, and the staged Owner1 = PipeChina 100% is a default, not a documented equity figure. WEP3 is the one Chinese trunk that was deliberately opened to outside capital, and the only equity split any primary document states is the 2012 PLANNED JV in Baosteel's SSE announcement 临 2012-050: 中国石油 325亿/约52%, 宝钢股份 80亿/约12.8%, 华宝投资 20亿/约3.2%, plus 全国社保基金 and 北京国联能源产业投资基金（有限合伙）; registered capital 625亿, 20-year term, '委托中石油集团下属管道运营专业公司负责项目建设和日常运行'. 国家能源局 2012-10-22 independently confirms the 2012-05-30 《西气东输三线管道项目合资合作框构协议》 with 中石油、全国社保基金理事会、城市基础设施产业投资基金、宝钢集团 and calls it '国内油气管道领域首创'. Every one of those figures is prospective (拟 / 框构协议) and NOTHING found in this pass confirms the JV was formed on those terms, survived the 2019-2020 PipeChina restructuring, or holds the pipe today. What IS documented today is operatorship, not equity: NDRC's 2023 appendix 《国家管网集团经营的跨省天然气管道表》 lists both WEP3 sections, and 国家管网集团西北公司 / 西气东输公司南昌输气分公司 run it. Note also that the sheet's own QCCOwner(业主单位) names 国家管网集团西部管道有限责任公司 first, i.e. a PipeChina SUBSIDIARY for the west section — if the merge prefers subsidiary-level precision over the parent, that is the candidate, and RELAUNCH_NOTES item 2's warning (the 46% Phase-I holder is the SUBSIDIARY 东部原油储运有限公司, not the parent) is the analogous trap here. RECOMMENDATION: apply PipeChina 100% consistently across the three trunk parents (P4657/P4934/P4947 all landed on the same value and tier), and adjudicate the 2012 minority stakes once, for the whole WEP3 family, rather than row by row.
